# Chalkboard

> Chalkboard is a learning company in Bengaluru, India. It runs small-batch school tuitions, interactive corporate training and placement programmes for colleges.

## Chalkboard Tuitions
Grew out of Home Tuitions Bangalore, which has taught since 2018.
- [Tuitions](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/tuitions): Daily small-batch tuitions for Grades 1–10 at 2nd Floor, Pooja Arcade, 50/2, Kammanahalli Main Rd, St Thomas Town, Bengaluru 560084 — near Kalyan Nagar, HRBR Layout and Banaswadi. Phone/WhatsApp +91 74114 46381. Maximum 8 students per batch. CBSE, ICSE and Karnataka State Board. Weekday batches, 4 PM to 8 PM. Free demo class.
- [Contact](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/contact): Book a free demo class.

## Chalkboard Learning Studio
Custom training built around what people need to be able to do. Based in Bengaluru, India; delivers on site and online.
- [Overview](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio): Training for companies (AI at work, sales, customer support, leadership) and colleges (placement readiness, industry tracks). A diagnosis first, then a design.
- [AI training for teams](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/ai-training): Hands-on generative AI training built on one rule: learners write the first draft themselves, then use AI to refine it. Covers prompt writing, AI-assisted work and checking AI output.
- [Colleges and universities](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/colleges): Campus recruitment training and industry tracks, set up under MOU. Running now at East Point College of Management, Bengaluru: a BCA Placement Accelerator (SQL, Python, Git/GitHub, Excel, Power BI) and a B.Com Industry Accelerator (FinTech track and a general branch). 80 students across both cohorts, no session missed.
- [Custom courses](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/custom-courses): Courses built from a company's own material, in the client's authoring tool (Storyline, Rise, Captivate and others), packaged as SCORM or xAPI with learner reporting. A new service, opening to first partners.
- [Our work](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/work): The East Point College case study.
- [Insights](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/insights): Writing on AI at work, college readiness and course design.
- [Trainers](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/trainers): Freelance trainers, subject experts and facilitators can send their profile.
